crossRefs.note: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz…
The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
The words of Amos, who was among the herdsmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of…
Yahweh’s word that came to Micah the Morashtite in the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, which he saw…
Yahweh’s voice calls to the city, and wisdom sees your name: “Listen to the rod, and he who appointed it.
The revelation which Habakkuk the prophet saw.
